title: pcf-edge-lean: A machine-checked Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the M9 Newton-edge algebraic core for polynomial continued fractions (conditional on H_edge)
description:
Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the purely algebraic / finitary core of the M9 Newton-edge lemma for polynomial continued fractions (PCFs) with unit numerator and partial denominator b(n) = Σk=0d βk nk (degree d ≥ 2, βd ≠ 0). It promotes the edge lemma from symbolically derived (sympy; hand induction) to machine-checked PROVEN for its finitary core, under the SIARC conditional-core pattern.

PROVEN (axiom cone exactly {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; zero sorry):

  • shift_leading_coeff (T1): composition with X+1 preserves the leading coefficient, i.e. [θd] b(θ+1) = βd.
  • edge_poly_closed_form (T2): 1 − βd(−(c/d))d = 1 + (−1)d+1(βd/dd)cd, stated d-free.
  • reindex_leading_coeff (T3a): lead(b ∘ (αX+γ)) = αd·βd (γ-independent).
  • xi0_covariance (T3b): with ξ0 = d/βd1/d (real rpow), ξ0(αdβd) = α−1ξ0(βd).

PROVEN CONDITIONAL on H_edge (cone additionally contains the explicit axioms borelRadius and edge_implies_borel_radius): borelRadius_covariance — the analytic Borel singularity radius transforms as ξ0(b∘φ) = α−1ξ0(b) for φ(n)=αn+γ, α>0.

Scope and epistemic honesty. The analytic step Newton edge ⇒ Borel singularity radius (Wasow §19 sectorial existence; Birkhoff–Trjitzinsky Borel summability) is OUT OF SCOPE and is encoded as an explicit, unproved axiom edge_implies_borel_radius (H_edge); it is NOT discharged here, and it appears in the axiom cone of the conditional end statement by design. The full complex root-set of χd is not formalized; the root-modulus fact G3 is captured for the real positive modulus via the rpow identity T3b. "PROVEN" here means a clean Lean axiom cone, strictly stronger than the source M9 grade "symbolically derived"; the conditional end statement is strictly weaker than its PROVEN core and is labeled as such.

Toolchain (pinned): Lean leanprover/lean4:v4.29.0; Mathlib rev 8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95 (inputRev v4.29.0), committed via lake-manifest.json. Reproduce the axiom cones by importing PcfEdge and running #print axioms on the five declarations.
